subject: Re: Migration evaluation - OpenAI API compatibility and perf comparison
messages:
From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@hyperfinco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Migration evaluation - OpenAI API compatibility and perf comparison

Thanks for the call earlier, Marissa - that was helpful. Quick recap of HyperFinCo's priorities and the ask so we're aligned:

- Goal: Replace our current OpenAI-based production endpoint with either a hosted or dedicated Redwood deployment to reduce per-token cost and gain more control over data residency.
- Must-haves: OpenAI-compatible API (minimal SDK changes), predictable 99th pct latency under 350ms for chat flows, and the ability to run side-by-side prompt diff tests on our 20 canonical prompts.
- Nice-to-haves: Explicit quantization profiles for our finance models, transparent fallback behavior to a smaller model during spikes, and integration with our SSO/KMS.
- Next tests we want you to run: (1) OpenAI API compatibility test (gpt-3.5/gpt-4 style endpoints, same prompt/params), (2) SDK swap demo (Node + Python sample swap), (3) prompt diff for our sample prompt set, and (4) 95/99 latency vs AWS/GCP endpoints.

Can you share a proposed scope & timeline for the above? Also please cc procurement (procurement@hyperfinco.com) with cost estimate for a 3-month pilot (dedicated capacity) + any required security docs.

-Alex
Alex Jones
Senior Engineering Manager, Core AI
HyperFinCo

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@hyperfinco.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Migration evaluation - OpenAI API compatibility and perf comparison

Alex - thanks for the clear summary and for looping procurement. We can run the four tests you outlined. Below is the proposed scope, rough timeline, and immediate asks so we can kick off this week if you'd like.

Scope (what we'll deliver)
- OpenAI API compatibility test: verify request/response parity for standard completion/chat endpoints and identify any prompt parameter diffs. Deliverable: compatibility report + code diff examples.
- SDK swap demo: provide Node and Python swap guides showing <10 lines change for token/credential handling and a sample repo you can run locally.
- Prompt diff run: execute your 20 canonical prompts across your current OpenAI endpoints and our Redwood hosted endpoint (and a Dedicated mock). Report will include token usage, response diffs, and qualitative scoring for hallucination/regression.
- Perf comparison: synthetic and replayed traffic tests against AWS/GCP endpoints measuring median/95/99 latencies and throughput.

Timeline (estimate)
- Kickoff & access: 1 business day after access granted
- Compatibility + SDK demo: 3 business days
- Prompt diffs & qualitative scoring: 5 business days
- Perf runs & combined report: 7 business days

Immediate asks from your side
- Provide the 20 canonical prompts (or a link to the Drive folder) and a small representative request trace (1k requests) if possible.
- Confirm whether the pilot will be hosted (Redwood API) or dedicated capacity so we size the trial properly.
- Security point of contact for SOC2/infra access requests (we'll send a short intake form).

Attachments: redwood-hyperscaler-compat-matrix.xlsx (compatibility checklist), redwood-sdk-swap-guide.pdf (sample swap snippets).

I'll loop in Rishi (commercial) and Neha (solutions) to handle pricing and config details if that's ok. Happy to hop on a 30m follow-up to align on access.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Also cc'd secops@hyperfinco.com - they'll handle the SOC2/access intake. If you need a signed NDA or DPA to proceed, let me know and I'll loop legal.

Alex - great, thanks. Quick update and next steps so everything is clear on our side:

1) Access & artifacts: please share the Drive link and masked trace. Once we have those we can kick off the compatibility and prompt diff runs immediately.

2) Pilot sizing: we can run a hosted pilot configured to replay 200 RPS peak (burst-aware) for the perf runs. Rishi will follow up with a one-page cost estimate for (a) 3-month hosted pilot and (b) committed dedicated 3-month option. Expect that in 24 business hours.

3) Security intake: Neha will send the SOC2/access questionnaire and a short list of evidence we typically need (ingress IPs, retention controls, KMS integration checklist). If you prefer, we can sign a DPA first - procurement, please advise.

4) Evaluation plan & deliverables:
- Day 0: kickoff and access granted
- Day 1-3: compatibility report + SDK swap sample repo
- Day 4-8: prompt diff run + qualitative scoring
- Day 9-15: perf runs + combined report with recommendations and suggested quantization profiles

5) Permissions request: we'll need permission to run side-by-side requests to your current OpenAI endpoints from our test harness and to store response payloads for diffing (we'll sign any required confidentiality terms).
